requirements.title: self-registration process for job seekers
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a self-registration process for job seekers.

requirements.title: account activation by user mobile number
requirements.description: The system SHALL support account activation by user mobile number

requirements.title: multi-level onboarding process
requirements.description: The system SHALL collect the following information from job seekers through a multi-level onboarding process (via mobile/email): - Level 1: First and last name, email, mobile number, password, gender - Level 2: Education, work experience, skills, training, certificates, recent salary (optional), current address, permanent address/residence - Level 3 (optional): Social media links (e.g., LinkedIn, IEEE, X), personal statement, bio

requirements.title: resume/CV upload
requirements.description: The system SHALL support resume/CV upload in common formats (PDF, DOCX, TXT).

requirements.title: AI parsing technology for CVs
requirements.description: The system SHALL offer the CV to AI engine to automatically extract information from uploaded resumes/CVs using AI parsing technology and add the extracted information to the profile.

requirements.title: staged, stepwise profile building
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow job seekers to build their profiles using a staged, stepwise form with popup prompts for the following sections: - Education: Degree, institution - Experience: Company, role, duration - Skills: Primary/secondary; soft/hard - Preferences: Job type, desired salary, preferred location

requirements.title: edit and update profiles
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow job seekers to edit and update their profiles at any time.

requirements.title: profile completion recommendations
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a recommendation to encourage job seekers to complete their profiles and to explore opportunities aligned with their broader skills, interests, and experiences beyond formal education and training.

requirements.title: set job preferences
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow job seekers to set job preferences including job type, industry, location, salary expectations, and work arrangements.

requirements.title: privacy controls
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide privacy controls that allow job seekers to set visibility preferences for their profile (public or private), and request account deactivation or deletion.

requirements.title: shareable public profile URL/QR Code
requirements.description: The system SHALL generate a shareable public profile URL/QR Code for each job seeker, if activated by the user.

requirements.title: upload supplementary documents
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow the job seeker to upload supplementary documents (i.e. certificate )

requirements.title: Stepwise registration process for employers
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a stepwise registration process for employers: - Level 1: Company name, email, mobile number, company ID, and registration number (if registered) - Level 2: Website, industry, company size, address, company description, and attachments for supplementary documents

requirements.title: Account activation through OTP
requirements.description: The system SHALL require account activation through a one-time password (OTP) sent to the registered mobile number.

requirements.title: Employer verification process
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide an employer verification process that includes automatic verification using official information such as the employer’s registration number, VAT number, and registered mobile number as recorded in government databases.

requirements.title: Manual verification by MoL
requirements.description: If automatic verification fails, the Ministry of Labor (MoL) SHALL be able to manually verify the employer’s account based on submitted registration details and/or direct contact.

requirements.title: Verified Employer badge
requirements.description: The system SHALL display a (cid:33061)(cid:57281) Verified Employer badge next to the names of verified companies to enhance trust for job seekers and provide added value to employers who complete the verification process.

requirements.title: Company profile page
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a company profile page that showcases the employer's information, job openings, and company background.

requirements.title: Upload company logo and images
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow employers to upload company logo, and images to enhance their profile. In addition to documents such as company registration and manage uploaded documents

requirements.title: Employer dashboard
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a dashboard for employers to manage job postings, view matched job seekers, create shortlists of interested or qualified candidates, and track key metrics.

requirements.title: Upload supplementary documents
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow the employer to upload supplementary documents (i.e. company registration certificate)

requirements.title: Registration and onboarding process for external job sites
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a registration and onboarding process for external job sites.

requirements.title: Unique API key or token for secure access
requirements.description: The system SHOULD issue a unique API key or token to each partner for secure access, with support for optional IP whitelisting, usage limits, and token expiration management to ensure controlled and secure integration.

requirements.title: Job posting via secure RESTful Push API
requirements.description: The system SHOULD support job posting via a secure RESTful Push API, allowing external platforms to submit job opportunities directly to the job matching system.

requirements.title: Data mapping and standard schema configuration
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow external job sites to configure data mapping between their system and the platform, provide the sites with the standard schema to successfully integrate with the platform

requirements.title: Testing environment for integration validation
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide a testing environment for external job sites to validate their integration.

requirements.title: Comprehensive error handling and response logging
requirements.description: The system SHOULD implement comprehensive error handling and response logging by providing clear API response codes with descriptive messages for success, failure, duplicates, and validation errors.

requirements.title: Access to submission logs
requirements.description: The system SHOULD grant external platforms access to view submission logs for monitoring and troubleshooting purposes.

requirements.title: Unique job ID confirmation response
requirements.description: The system SHOULD return a unique job ID as a confirmation response after a job is successfully pushed via the API, enabling accurate record-keeping and integration synchronization for external systems.

requirements.title: Automatic source platform tagging and backlinking
requirements.description: The system SHALL automatically tag each job post with the name of the source platform (e.g., “Source: samplejobsite.ps”) and include a backlink to the original job advertisement.

requirements.title: Job synchronization of updates via API
requirements.description: The system SHOULD support job synchronization of updates via the API, enabling external job sites to modify job details—such as deadline extensions, description edits, or early closure/deletion/deactivation—using the assigned job ID.

requirements.title: Optional sync dashboard
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide an optional sync dashboard—a lightweight web interface or endpoint—that allows partners to review the status of jobs posted via the API, including indicators for synced, failed, pending, and archived records.

requirements.title: Integration usage statistics access
requirements.description: The system SHOULD also offer periodic or real-time access to integration usage statistics—such as the number of jobs submitted, matched, and viewed—for transparency, performance tracking, and reporting purposes.

requirements.title: Access to API schema and validation rules
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide access to the up-to-date API schema (e.g., via Swagger) and detailed field validation rules to ensure proper formatting and structure of job postings submitted through the API.

requirements.title: Attribution visibility configuration
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide an option for source platforms to configure whether their attribution (e.g., source platform name) appears publicly on job postings or is only visible within the admin panel and system logs.

requirements.title: Job-level audit trail
requirements.description: The system SHOULD maintain an audit trail at the job level, recording which external job site created or modified each posting, and display this information within the MoL admin dashboard for traceability and accountability.

requirements.title: comprehensive user management interface for administrators
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a comprehensive user management interface for administrators.

requirements.title: add and manage core entities on the platform
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow authorized administrators to add and manage core entities on the platform, including job seekers, employers, and job offerings (opportunities).

requirements.title: user management capabilities for administrators
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide user management capabilities for administrators, including the ability to view, approve, ban, or deactivate user accounts, reset account credentials, and monitor account statuses.

requirements.title: tools for administrators to assist users and approve employer registrations
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide tools for administrators to assist users with account recovery and technical issues, view pending employer registrations and approve them based on submitted profile information.

requirements.title: audit log of all administrative actions
requirements.description: The system SHALL maintain an audit log of all administrative actions for security and accountability.

requirements.title: define and update system settings
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow authorized administrators to define and update system settings if needed.

requirements.title: view and manage static reference files
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow authorized administrators to view and manage static reference files, including skills, jobs, trainings, and other related datasets.

requirements.title: manage system taxonomies
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow authorized administrators to manage system taxonomies such as the skills list, occupations catalog, training programs, and other platform constants or reference values.

requirements.title: oversee job offerings
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow administrators to oversee job offerings by viewing active and inactive postings, changes in posts, and to suspend or remove job offerings that are deemed inappropriate or violate platform policies.

requirements.title: comprehensive statistics and reporting features
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide comprehensive statistics and reporting features, allowing administrators to download reports on job postings by sector, region, or industry; user registrations; top searches from both job seekers and employers; user interactions with job offers; and overall system metrics.

requirements.title: secure authentication mechanisms
requirements.description: The system SHALL implement secure authentication mechanisms including username/password, email verification, and multi-factor authentication options.

requirements.title: strong password policies
requirements.description: The system SHALL enforce strong password policies with configurable parameters.

requirements.title: role-based access control
requirements.description: The system SHALL implement role-based access control to restrict access to features and data based on user roles.

requirements.title: session management
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide session management with configurable timeout settings.

requirements.title: detailed access logs
requirements.description: The system SHALL maintain detailed access logs for security monitoring and auditing.

requirements.title: Structured job posting form
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a structured job posting form for employers to create job listings.

requirements.title: Job posting form fields
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a structured job posting form that allows employers to add new job opportunities with the following fields: - Job title, summary, and required skills (with support for file upload or copy/paste input) - Contract type (e.g., full-time, part-time, training, project-based) - Required education level - Application deadline with an optional auto-close feature - Work format selection (Physical with employment location, Online, or Hybrid) - Gender, number of employees, etc - Required languages and proficiency levels - Link to the job if available. - More detailed features on the job post to be provided.

requirements.title: Standardized job categories and Schema.org compliance
requirements.description: The system SHALL support standardized job categories, skills, and qualifications to facilitate accurate matching. For this requirement, the system SHALL ensure that all input data complies with the Schema.org JobPosting standard for semantic compatibility and structured data integrity.

requirements.title: Job posting management
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow employers to manage their job postings by editing job details, extending application deadlines, and set job posting visibility (public, private, or targeted) posts when necessary.

requirements.title: Job posting expiration and renewal
requirements.description: The system SHALL support job posting expiration and renewal processes.

requirements.title: Comprehensive search interface
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a comprehensive search interface for job seekers to find relevant opportunities.

requirements.title: Basic and advanced search modes
requirements.description: The search interface SHALL support both basic (search by single keyword) and advanced search modes based on employer-defined attributes.

requirements.title: Semantic search capabilities
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide semantic search capabilities that understand the intent behind search queries.

requirements.title: Advanced filtering capabilities
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a search engine with advanced filtering capabilities, allowing job seekers to search for jobs using the following criteria: - Keywords (text) - Location - Salary range - Employment type - Date posted - Application deadline - Job-specific requirements (e.g., skills, education, training, years of experience) - Company sector/industry (e.g., IT, Health, NGO, Construction)

requirements.title: Search results ranking and AI recommendations
requirements.description: The system SHALL display search results with relevance/skills-matching ranking and sorting options. In addition, when user login the system SHALL display recommended jobs based on results generated by AI matching engine.

requirements.title: Favorites feature
requirements.description: The system SHALL also include a favorites feature (e.g., heart button ) for users to save jobs of interest.

requirements.title: Saved searches and notifications
requirements.description: The system SHALL support saved searches with notification options for new matching jobs.

requirements.title: Bookmark and save jobs
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow job seekers to bookmark and save jobs by adding them to an “Interested List ”, and to save custom search filters for future use.

requirements.title: Job posting status management tools
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide employers with tools to manage the status of job postings.

requirements.title: Job posting statuses
requirements.description: The system SHALL support the following job posting statuses: draft, active, paused, expired, and archived.

requirements.title: Status change history
requirements.description: The system SHALL maintain a history of status changes for audit and reporting purposes.

requirements.title: AI-driven matching algorithms
requirements.description: The system SHALL implement AI-driven matching algorithms to connect job seekers with relevant job opportunities.

requirements.title: Scoring algorithm
requirements.description: The system SHALL use a scoring algorithm to calculate a match score between job seekers and job postings minimally based on the following criteria: - Skill overlap - Education match - Training match - Location match - Experience range - Salary expectation range

requirements.title: Shortlists of top-matching candidates
requirements.description: The system SHALL generate shortlists of top-matching candidates (e.g., top 100) for each job posting to assist employers in the selection process.

requirements.title: Natural language processing (NLP)
requirements.description: The system SHALL use natural language processing (NLP) to understand the semantic meaning of job descriptions and resumes beyond keyword matching.

requirements.title: Keyword and semantic analysis
requirements.description: The system SHALL perform keyword and semantic analysis on posted job descriptions to identify key attributes such as required skills, experience levels, and job categories.

requirements.title: Minimum match threshold
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow administrators to define and adjust a minimum match threshold (e.g., 60%) that determines which job matches are displayed to users.

requirements.title: Rank/order job postings
requirements.description: The system SHALL rank/order job postings for each job seeker based on their individual match percentage, displaying the most relevant opportunities first.

requirements.title: Two-way matching
requirements.description: The system SHALL support two-way matching, where job seekers receive ranked job opportunities based on match percentage, and employers receive reverse matches with ranked lists of suitable job seekers for their postings.

requirements.title: Configuration of matching parameters
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow configuration of matching parameters to adjust the importance of different factors.

requirements.title: AI-powered resume parsing
requirements.description: The system SHALL implement AI-powered resume parsing to extract structured information from uploaded documents.

requirements.title: Information extraction from resumes
requirements.description: The system SHALL extract the following information from resumes: personal details, contact information, education history, work experience, skills, certifications, and achievements.

requirements.title: Multiple languages in resume parsing
requirements.description: The system SHALL support multiple languages in resume parsing, with primary focus on Arabic and English.

requirements.title: Standardize skills
requirements.description: The system SHALL identify and standardize skills mentioned in resumes to facilitate matching.

requirements.title: Confidence scores for extracted information
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide confidence scores for extracted information and highlight areas that may need manual verification.

requirements.title: Review and correct parsed information
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow job seekers to review and correct parsed information.

requirements.title: Personalized job recommendations
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide personalized job recommendations for job seekers based on their profile, preferences, and platform activity.

requirements.title: Recommend suitable job seekers
requirements.description: The system SHALL recommend suitable job seekers to employers based on job requirements and matching criteria.

requirements.title: Collaborative filtering
requirements.description: The system SHALL use collaborative filtering to recommend jobs based on similar user behaviors and preferences.

requirements.title: Content-based filtering
requirements.description: The system SHALL incorporate content-based filtering to recommend jobs similar to those the user has shown interest in.

requirements.title: Recommendation considerations
requirements.description: The system SHALL consider location, salary expectations, and work arrangement preferences in recommendations.

requirements.title: Candidate recommendations for employers
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide employers with candidate recommendations for their job postings.

requirements.title: Rank candidates based on match quality
requirements.description: The system SHALL rank candidates based on match quality, highlighting the strengths and potential gaps of each candidate.

requirements.title: Minimum qualification thresholds for automatic candidate filtering
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow employers to set minimum qualification thresholds for automatic candidate filtering.

requirements.title: Search candidate database using advanced filtering options
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow employers to search the candidate database using advanced filtering options.

requirements.title: Respect candidate privacy settings
requirements.description: The system SHALL respect candidate privacy settings when making recommendations to employers.

requirements.title: Insights on candidate availability, salary expectations, and potential fit
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide insights on candidate availability, salary expectations, and potential fit.

requirements.title: Save promising candidates to talent pools
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow employers to save promising candidates to talent pools for future opportunities (add to shortlist).

requirements.title: Integration with external job sites
requirements.description: The system SHALL support integration with external job sites based on recommendations by MoL and PEF.

requirements.title: APIs for real-time job data synchronization
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide APIs for real-time job data synchronization with external job sites.

requirements.title: Data mapping and transformation for job postings
requirements.description: The system SHOULD implement data mapping and transformation to standardize job postings from different sources.

requirements.title: Pull and push integration models
requirements.description: The system SHOULD support both pull (importing jobs from external sites) and push (exporting jobs to external sites) integration models.

requirements.title: Synchronization logs and error handling
requirements.description: The system SHOULD maintain synchronization logs and provide error handling for failed integrations.

requirements.title: Scheduled and on-demand synchronization options
requirements.description: The system SHOULD support scheduled and on-demand synchronization options.

requirements.title: Dashboard to monitor integration status and data flow
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide a dashboard to monitor integration status and data flow with external job sites.

requirements.title: Integration with government databases
requirements.description: The system SHOULD integrate with relevant government databases for data verification and enrichment.

requirements.title: Integration with MoL and PEF databases and systems
requirements.description: The system SHOULD support integration with the MoL and PEF existing databases and systems.

requirements.title: Verification of educational credentials
requirements.description: The system SHOULD support verification of educational credentials through integration with educational institution databases.

requirements.title: Identity verification through government ID systems
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide options for identity verification through government ID systems.

requirements.title: Audit trails of data exchanges with government systems
requirements.description: The system SHOULD maintain audit trails of all data exchanges with government systems.

requirements.title: Respect data privacy regulations for government data
requirements.description: The system SHOULD respect data privacy regulations when accessing and using government data.

requirements.title: Comprehensive API framework
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide a comprehensive API framework for integration with external systems.

requirements.title: RESTful APIs with JSON data format
requirements.description: The system SHOULD implement RESTful APIs with JSON data format as the primary integration method.

requirements.title: Detailed API documentation
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide detailed API documentation with examples and testing tools.

requirements.title: OAuth 2.0 for API authentication and authorization
requirements.description: The system SHOULD implement OAuth 2.0 for API authentication and authorization.

requirements.title: API versioning for backward compatibility
requirements.description: The system SHOULD support API versioning to ensure backward compatibility.

requirements.title: Track and record user activities
requirements.description: The system SHALL track and record user activities for analysis and reporting.

requirements.title: Monitor job seeker activities
requirements.description: The system SHALL monitor job seeker activities including profile views, job searches, applications, and interactions.

requirements.title: Track employer activities
requirements.description: The system SHALL TRACK employer activities including job postings, candidate searches.

requirements.title: Data retention policies for activity logs
requirements.description: The system SHALL implement data retention policies for activity logs in compliance with regulations.

requirements.title: MOL Life dashboard user session details
requirements.description: MOL Life dashboard should include current logins, number of current logins and last sessions, with links to these users profiles

requirements.title: generate employment statistics and labor market insights from platform data
requirements.description: The system SHOULD generate employment statistics and labor market insights from platform data.

requirements.title: track key metrics including job posting trends, application rates, hiring rates, and time-to-fill
requirements.description: The system SHOULD track key metrics including job posting trends, application rates, hiring rates, and time-to-fill.

requirements.title: provide industry-specific analytics on job market demand and supply
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide industry-specific analytics on job market demand and supply.

requirements.title: analyze skill demand trends to identify emerging requirements and skill gaps
requirements.description: The system SHOULD analyze skill demand trends to identify emerging requirements and skill gaps.

requirements.title: generate geographic distribution reports for jobs and candidates
requirements.description: The system SHOULD generate geographic distribution reports for jobs and candidates.

requirements.title: provide salary range analytics by industry, position, and location
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide salary range analytics by industry, position, and location.

requirements.title: track employment outcomes and career progression where data is available
requirements.description: The system SHOULD track employment outcomes and career progression where data is available.

requirements.title: generate periodic labor market reports for government stakeholders
requirements.description: The system SHOULD generate periodic labor market reports for government stakeholders.

requirements.title: monitor and report on system performance metrics
requirements.description: The system SHOULD monitor and report on system performance metrics.

requirements.title: track matching algorithm performance including accuracy, precision, recall, and user satisfaction
requirements.description: The system SHOULD track matching algorithm performance including accuracy, precision, recall, and user satisfaction.

requirements.title: monitor system usage patterns including peak times, popular features, and user engagement
requirements.description: The system SHOULD monitor system usage patterns including peak times, popular features, and user engagement.

requirements.title: track technical performance metrics including response times, resource utilization, and error rates
requirements.description: The system SHOULD track technical performance metrics including response times, resource utilization, and error rates.

requirements.title: provide dashboards for administrators to monitor system health and performance
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide dashboards for administrators to monitor system health and performance.

requirements.title: generate alerts for performance issues or anomalies
requirements.description: The system SHOULD generate alerts for performance issues or anomalies.

requirements.title: maintain historical performance data for trend analysis and capacity planning
requirements.description: The system SHOULD maintain historical performance data for trend analysis and capacity planning.

requirements.title: provide a flexible reporting framework for generating custom reports through seamless integration with existing and available reporting tools such as Microsoft Power BI
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide a flexible reporting framework for generating custom reports through seamless integration with existing and available reporting tools such as Microsoft Power BI.

requirements.title: allow administrators to define report templates with configurable parameters
requirements.description: The system SHOULD allow administrators to define report templates with configurable parameters.

requirements.title: support various report formats including tabular data, charts, and visualizations
requirements.description: The system SHOULD support various report formats including tabular data, charts, and visualizations.

requirements.title: allow scheduling of recurring reports with automated distribution
requirements.description: The system SHOULD allow scheduling of recurring reports with automated distribution.

requirements.title: support export of reports in common formats (PDF, Excel, CSV)
requirements.description: The system SHOULD support export of reports in common formats (PDF, Excel, CSV).

requirements.title: provide a report builder interface for users with appropriate permissions
requirements.description: The system SHOULD provide a report builder interface for users with appropriate permissions.

requirements.title: maintain a library of saved reports for quick access
requirements.description: The system SHOULD maintain a library of saved reports for quick access.

requirements.title: implement access controls to ensure users can only view reports appropriate to their role
requirements.description: The system SHOULD implement access controls to ensure users can only view reports appropriate to their role.

requirements.title: send email notifications for important events and updates
requirements.description: The system SHALL send email notifications for important events and updates.

requirements.title: support customizable email templates with dynamic content
requirements.description: The system SHALL support customizable email templates with dynamic content.

requirements.title: allow users to configure their email notification preferences
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow users to configure their email notification preferences.

requirements.title: support both immediate and digest email notifications
requirements.description: The system SHALL support both immediate and digest email notifications.

requirements.title: log all emails notifications
requirements.description: The system SHALL log all emails notifications.

requirements.title: comply with anti-spam regulations and best practices
requirements.description: The system SHALL comply with anti-spam regulations and best practices.

requirements.title: In-app notification center
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide an in-app notification center for users.

requirements.title: Real-time notifications
requirements.description: The system SHALL display real-time notifications for important events and updates.

requirements.title: Weekly job recommendations
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide weekly job recommendations to job seekers based on their search history and profile information.

requirements.title: Notification history
requirements.description: The system SHALL maintain a notification history for users to review past notifications.

requirements.title: In-app notification preferences
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow users to configure their in-app notification preferences.

requirements.title: Notification types and visual indicators
requirements.description: The system SHALL support different notification types with appropriate visual indicators.

requirements.title: Notification management tools
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide notification management tools for users to mark as read, delete, or take action on notifications.

requirements.title: SMS notifications for critical updates
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide SMS notifications for critical updates and time- sensitive information (byt the integration with SMS service providers (gateway)). Such as welcoming SMS with a code for user registration, employer registration, and SMS for resetting the password.

requirements.title: SMS opt-in
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow users to opt-in to SMS notifications and provide their mobile number.

requirements.title: Limit SMS notifications
requirements.description: The system SHALL limit SMS notifications to essential communications to avoid overwhelming users.

requirements.title: SMS delivery tracking
requirements.description: The system SHALL track SMS delivery status for monitoring and troubleshooting. + loging as sms messages

requirements.title: SMS regulation compliance
requirements.description: The system SHALL comply with telecommunications regulations regarding SMS messaging.

requirements.title: Content management system (CMS)
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a content management system (CMS) for publishing news and updates.

requirements.title: Admin content management
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow administrators to create, edit, and publish articles and announcements.

requirements.title: Rich text and media support
requirements.description: The system SHALL support rich text formatting, images, and embedded media in content.

requirements.title: Content categorization and tagging
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide content categorization and tagging for organization.

requirements.title: Profile-based news display
requirements.description: The system SHALL display relevant news and updates on user dashboards based on their profile.

requirements.title: News and updates archive
requirements.description: The system SHALL maintain an archive of past news and updates with search functionality.

requirements.title: FAQ and help center
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide a comprehensive FAQ and help center. In addition, list of laws, regulations and contract types regulations.

requirements.title: Help content organization
requirements.description: The system SHALL organize help content by topic and user role for easy navigation.

requirements.title: Help content search
requirements.description: The system SHALL implement a search function for help content.

requirements.title: Context-sensitive help
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide context-sensitive help throughout the platform.

requirements.title: Admin help content updates
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow administrators to update help content as the system evolves.

requirements.title: Help content feedback
requirements.description: The system SHALL collect user feedback on help content effectiveness.

requirements.title: Guided tours and tutorials
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide guided tours and tutorials for new users.

requirements.title: Multimedia help content
requirements.description: The system SHALL support multimedia help content including videos and interactive guides.

requirements.id: The system shall support the migration of existing data from MoL and PEF systems into the new platform
requirements.title: Data Migration
requirements.description: The system shall support the migration of existing data from MoL and PEF systems into the new platform. This includes: 1) Data Mapping and Transformation - Mapping of existing data structures to new system schema - Transformation of data to meet new system requirements - Validation of migrated data for accuracy and completeness 2) Migration Process - Phased migration approach to minimize disruption - Testing procedures for migrated data - Rollback procedures in case of migration issues 3) Data Cleansing - Identification and resolution of data quality issues - Deduplication of records - Standardization of data formats

requirements.id: The system shall include provisions for training different user groups
requirements.title: Training Requirements
requirements.description: The system shall include provisions for training different user groups: 1) Administrator Training - System configuration and management - User administration - Security management - Troubleshooting and support 2) End-User Training - Job seeker training materials - Employer training materials - External job site integration training - Self-service training resources 3) Training Delivery - Online training modules - In-person training sessions - Train-the-trainer programs - Ongoing training for system updates
